metadata.title: Pionni del Alevtonni — Handmade Italian Peonies for Luxury Interiors
metadata.description: Italian soul in your interior: hand-sculpted peonies crafted from premium Italian materials for executive offices, boutiques, and private residences.

pillars.p1Text: Every peony is shaped by hand by Italian artisans: dozens of silky petals capture organic movement, morning curvature, and the natural depth of a blooming flower.
pillars.p2Text: Patented soft-touch botanical composite from Lombardy feels indistinguishable from live blooms, resists spotlight fading, and holds its architectural silhouette for decades.
pillars.p3Text: From disciplined boardrooms to flagship fashion boutiques — sculptural peonies instantly establish the poise of a European salon and draw every guest's eye.

catalog.heading: Sculptural arrangements for offices, boutiques, and residences

nero-di-milano.description: Powder blush and ivory peonies set in a monolithic matte volcanic-stone vessel. Designed for central plinths and concept-store window displays.
nero-di-milano.alt: Handmade Italian peonies Nero di Milano arrangement inside a luxury boutique

aeterna-velluto.description: A high-contrast ensemble of milk-white and deep burgundy peonies tailored for reception desks and executive meeting tables.
aeterna-velluto.alt: White and burgundy peony arrangement Aeterna Velluto on an office reception desk

palazzo-grand.description: A commanding vertical installation in champagne and dusty rose hues inside a hand-blown glass vase. Anchors lounge zones and grand lobbies.
palazzo-grand.alt: Tall architectural peony installation Palazzo Grand in a contemporary lounge

botanica-pura.description: An intimate bouquet with fine artisan shading on every petal and lifelike foliage texture. Ideal for living rooms, studies, and dressing suites.
botanica-pura.alt: Artisan hands shaping Italian peony petals for Botanica Pura

metrics.heading: The economics of enduring luxury botanicals

items.label: Hand-formed petals
items.detail: Each statement bloom is assembled from dozens of individually cut and hand-tinted petals.

items.label: Colorfast longevity
items.detail: Lightfast Italian pigments preserve their chromatic depth under gallery spotlights and daylight.

items.label: Artisan work per piece
items.detail: Precision stem sculpting and bloom calibration tailored to the proportions of your space.

items.label: Maintenance & replacement cost
items.detail: No watering, zero fallen petals, and no recurring weekly floristry invoices.

reviews.heading: An impression that elevates your brand every day

items.quote: After placing Nero di Milano in the center of our showroom, clients started photographing the display far more often and lingering by the fitting rooms. Eight months in, the blooms look as crisp as day one.
items.author: Valeria Morozova

items.quote: Fresh bouquets on our architecture firm's reception desk had to be replaced every four days. Aeterna Velluto looks so lifelike that visiting partners instinctively lean in to catch the scent.
items.author: Andrei Kravchenko
items.context: Office & Boardroom · Up to € 3,200 saved annually

items.quote: For our lobby lounge we needed a focal piece impervious to round-the-clock air conditioning and warm evening lighting. Palazzo Grand became the visual anchor of the room from the very first day.
items.author: Elena Russu

contact.heading: Tailored to the architecture of your space
contact.description: We match petal tones to your interior finishes, size each vessel for your storefront or boardroom, and arrange careful delivery with on-site styling.
contact.hours: Daily from 09:00 to 20:00 · Bespoke selection from interior photos
